key_points.evidence_span: الطلاب يذهب إلى المدرسة كل صباح.
key_points.reasoning: The sentence contains a subject-verb agreement error, so it is not a correct grammatical sentence as required.

language_errors.explanation: With the subject fronted before the verb (topic-comment order), the verb must agree in number, so the plural subject الطلاب requires the plural verb يذهبون.

holistic_note: You were asked to write a correct sentence, but this one has a subject-verb agreement error: الطلاب (plural) needs يذهبون, not يذهب.
